europe_now.title: Ukraine Conflict and Major Bridge Strike
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian forces targeted the strategic Crimean Bridge amid a massive wave of drone attacks reported across the region. The incident highlights the ongoing escalation of infrastructure strikes in the protracted conflict.

sources.headline: Ukraine damages Crimean Bridge, drones likely hit arch (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,726)
Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war

europe_now.title: Five EU Nations Pursue Rwanda Migrant Hub
europe_now.summary: A group of five European Union countries has advanced plans to establish a deportation return hub for rejected asylum seekers in Rwanda. The initiative moves forward despite key operational details remaining undisclosed.

sources.headline: Rwanda to host hub for rejected EU migrants
Five EU countries tout Rwanda deportation partnership but no formal deal as key details remain secret

top_stories.title: European Union Sanctions Russian Disinformation Actors
top_stories.summary: The European Union has implemented new sanctions targeting Russian propagandists and hackers involved in malicious cyber operations. Officials noted that thousands of fake online accounts continue attempts to target democratic voters.

sources.headline: More EU sanctions on Russian propagandists and hackers, as thousands of fake accounts target voters

top_stories.title: Czech Citizens Protest Government Media Funding Plan
top_stories.summary: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Prague to voice strong opposition to a contentious government media funding proposal. Protestors argued that the planned overhaul poses a direct threat to the independence of public broadcasting.

sources.headline: Czech mass protests: Media is the first casualty 'when you want to attack democracy'
Prague: Thousands of Czechs rally against government media funding plan
